heading: Learn Danish from first words to C1.
lead: Standard Danish as it is spoken in Denmark, in 77 modules across eight tiers: from the vowels, the soft d and the stød to the passives, nominal style, academic Danish and the dialects. Many learners read Danish long before they understand it spoken, so every module has a listening activity, and spoken Danish at full speed has modules of its own. Grammar is explained directly, and every answer gets feedback with a reason.
fineprint: The whole course, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free. Specializations, Prøve i Dansk and Studieprøven practice papers and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.

panel.label: The course, tier by tier

items.title: 1 · Sounds and first words
items.text: The letters and vowels, the soft d, the stød, greetings, en and et, the present tense, numbers.

items.title: 2 · Everyday basics
items.text: Definite forms, plurals, adjectives, verb-second word order, questions and negation, telling the time.

items.title: 3 · Daily life
items.text: Verb groups and the imperative, modal verbs, prepositions of place, food, the city, shopping.

items.title: 4 · The past
items.text: The past tense, the perfect, irregular verbs, the future, reflexives, travel, health and the home.

items.title: 5 · Building fluency
items.text: Subordinate clauses, particle verbs, comparison, the s-passive, everyday speech.

items.title: 6 · Intermediate
items.text: Relative clauses, the conditional, reported speech, the blive-passive, the small words of spoken Danish.

items.title: 7 · Upper intermediate
items.text: Nominal style, connectors, word formation, fixed prepositions, Danish society, official Danish.

items.title: 8 · Advanced
items.text: Advanced word order, style, spoken Danish and the dialects, literature, academic Danish.

panel.note: 77 modules in all. A placement test lets you start further up if you already know some Danish.

sections.heading: A course built for understanding Danish, written and spoken

items.title: Listening in every module
items.text: Each tier has a listening focus, from telling single vowels apart in Tier 1 to the reduced forms of everyday speech in Tier 5, radio-style news in Tier 6 and fast, unscripted-sounding conversation in Tier 8.

items.title: Grammar explained, not hidden
items.text: Each grammar module states the rule: when a noun takes -en or -et, why the verb comes second, where ikke goes in a subordinate clause. The grammar reference keeps every rule in one place.

items.title: Feedback that says why
items.text: A wrong answer is marked with the correct form and the reason, with a link to the rule. Answers are graded on the server, the same way every time.

items.title: Every word inspectable
items.text: Tap any Danish word in an exercise, text or story for its meaning, its forms and audio.

items.title: Speaking with pronunciation feedback
items.text: Danish has pronunciation assessment, so the course includes exercises where you say a word or a sentence and get feedback on each word.

items.title: Common traps
items.text: Twelve short sets on the mistakes English speakers make, from halv tre and halvtreds to synes, tror and mener, ligge and lægge, sin and false friends.

sections.heading: Practice papers for Prøve i Dansk and Studieprøven
sections.intro: The course has two timed practice papers for each of the Danish exams for adult foreigners set by SIRI, in their reading and writing formats with original content. The Danish exams page says what they cover and where they differ from the real exams.
items: Prøve i Dansk 1 (PD1), the exam at the end of Danskuddannelse 1: two papers.
Prøve i Dansk 2 (PD2), one of the requirements for permanent residence: two papers.
Prøve i Dansk 3 (PD3), at B2, linked to applications for Danish citizenship: two papers.
Studieprøven, at C1, which many universities and colleges accept for their Danish-language requirement: two papers.
No speaking part, and no mark on the 7-point scale: each paper has a short listening section of Glossa's own and shows the share of points.

sections.heading: Danish for your field
sections.intro: Thirteen specialization courses, each with nine modules in three stages (foundations, working vocabulary, professional) that open as you reach Tiers 4, 6 and 8 of the core course:

items.question: Is the Danish course really free?
items.answer: Yes. All 77 modules from A1 to C1, the grammar reference, word practice, the common traps and the placement test are free, with 5 Ask AI questions a day. Premium adds the specializations, exam papers, stories, conversations and the other extras.

items.question: Which Danish does it teach?
items.answer: Standard Danish of Denmark, as educated speakers in and around Copenhagen speak it and as it is heard on DR and TV 2. Tier 8 has modules on spoken Danish at full speed and on the dialects and other varieties, for recognition.

items.question: I already know some Danish. Do I have to start from the beginning?
items.answer: No. The placement test tells you which tier to start from.

items.question: Does it prepare for Prøve i Dansk?
items.answer: It has two timed practice papers each for PD1, PD2, PD3 and Studieprøven, in the reading and writing formats of the real exams. There is no speaking part, and the papers cannot tell you which mark you would get. The Danish exams page has the details.

items.question: I speak Swedish or Norwegian. Is there a version for me?
items.answer: Yes. Danish for Swedish speakers (40 modules) and Danish for Norwegian speakers (30 modules) are shorter courses, with explanations in Swedish or Norwegian, that build on what your language already gives you and spend their time on what is different, above all on understanding spoken Danish.
